title: The Pentagon fails another audit. Can it turn things around by 2028? - Breaking Defense
html:
For the ninth year in a row, the Pentagon has failed its annual financial audit. This year’s review covered $4.9 trillion in assets and $5.2 trillion in liabilities, with the department reporting incremental improvements despite falling short of a clean opinion.

In this episode of The Pentagon Buzz, reporter Ashley Roque reviews what’s behind the latest audit troubles, how much progress the department has made and why Pentagon Comptroller Jules Hurst believes a change in strategy could finally produce a clean bill of financial health.

Subscribe to our Pentagon newsletter to get the latest information from the building delivered directly to you.
summary: The Defense Department has struggled for years to get its books in order. Now, officials say a new approach could change that.
